effect_size_guard.naive_conclusion: subspace-SFI improves prediction, p=2.0e-24 at N=55000 -> 'it works'
effect_size_guard.rigorous_conclusion: effect size dAUC=+0.0028; needs ~4152 cases for 80% power; clinical cohorts ~200-1000 -> undetectable, useless

summary: A naive analyst (random CV + p-value threshold, no effect-size gate) would report SFI as a working biomarker. The pre-registered protocol (shape-family GroupKFold + DeLong + effect-size gate + spatial nulls) correctly rejects it. Each guard, removed, manufactures a specific false positive.
